520:t_3:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Then the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and $$クォーター$$ have uncovered $$アマルガム$$'s ultimate objective?」

520:t_3:19.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We don't know the details, either. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s transmission only informed us of an emergency and a rendezvous point.」

520:t_3:20.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll descend into the atmosphere and hurry to the rendezvous point, too.」

520:t_3:21.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We'll hear the details of the situation from her there.」

520:t_3:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We've identified $$ガイゾック$$ as the source of the mysterious robot army, and confirmed the return of $$皇帝ズール$$, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, and $$ミケーネ$$'s $$ハーデス$$.」

520:t_3:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「They've returned at a time like this...」

520:t_3:24.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But we defended Japan, and the $$トライダー$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$, $$ダイターン３$$, $$ゴッドマーズ$$, $$鉄人２８号#robot$$...」

520:t_3:25.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「and the $$マジンガーＺ$$, $$真ゲッターロボ$$, and $$ダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッド$$ have all powered up.」

520:t_3:26.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The $$くろがね五人衆$$ and Prince $$グーラ$$ have also joined us to help.」

520:t_3:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That's a major increase in our strength.」

520:t_3:28.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ and $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, the $$真ゲッター１$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and the three Invincible Robots can now use combination attacks.」

520:t_3:29.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But all this power will be meaningless if the world is destroyed...」

520:t_3:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But destroying the world... I can't understand their intentions at all.」

520:t_3:31.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All the answers lie where we're headed.」

520:t_3:32.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If the rendezvous point is off $$相模湾$$...」

520:t_3:33.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Our final battle with $$アマルガム$$ will probably be at the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

520:t_3:34.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I hope you'll join us as soon as possible.」

520:t_3:36.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then, what about the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$...」

520:t_3:37.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can I entrust it to you, Captain $$ジンネマン$$?」

520:t_3:39.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...You once pointed out there were things I couldn't see because I'm a Federation man.」

520:t_3:40.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Forgive the intrusion, but I looked into your history and what happened after the $$一年戦争$$.」

520:t_3:42.en:
$$ブライト$$
「An apology can't resolve this, but allow me to apologize as a soldier of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

520:t_3:44.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I have a family, too... I can understand a little of your anguish.」

520:t_3:45.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's precisely because you've overcome it that I believe you're worthy of trust.」

520:t_3:46.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm... a weak man. I might... betray you again...」

520:t_3:47.en:
$$ブライト$$
「However weak a person is, there's a line they can hold. I believe the man you are now can hold it.」

520:t_3:48.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can I entrust the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ to you?」

520:t_3:49.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I swear it on my late wife and daughter.」

520:t_3:52.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Tell Miss $$スメラギ$$, too. $c will head to Earth as soon as possible.」

520:t_3:53.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Whatever $$アマルガム$$'s objective, we can't allow the destruction of the world.」

520:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why did $$フロンタル$$ remove his mask when he spoke of his plan?」

520:t_10:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「...A mask signifies lies and deception. He probably intended to speak his true intentions, in his own way.」

520:t_10:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「But in the end, we only confirmed that we were incompatible.」

520:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I hear $$フロンタル$$ contains your consciousness from a parallel world, $$シャア$$...」

520:t_10:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even the same person from a parallel world is still someone else.」

520:t_10:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「But whatever the source of his methods or sense of duty, I confirmed that he, too, cared about the world's fate.」

520:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Surely that is the mark of $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

520:t_10:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「If things had been just a little different, we might have become comrades who understood each other from the bottom of our hearts...」

520:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, would you do one to commemorate your return?」

520:t_10:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「I've already performed the ritual. Please spare me.」

520:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I'll welcome you myself, $$シャア$$...! Once again, let's get fired up... Business, business!」

520:t_10:18.en:
$$シャア$$
(Did $$ハマーン$$ do this, too, while I was away...?)

521:t_000:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「I never thought we'd separate $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and cut their strength nearly in half.」

521:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've returned with results beyond expectations... This is truly a triumphant homecoming.」

521:t_000:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I think it's still too early to savor victory...」

521:t_000:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「I know that, too. But a little won't hurt.」

521:t_000:4.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...You're right. The crew is tired from constant battles, so I hope this stay lets them catch their breath.」

521:t_000:5.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「A guidance beacon has arrived from the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

521:t_000:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's good...! We'll enter port after the $$ラー・カイラム$$.」

521:t_001:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces occupying the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ have deployed!」

521:t_001:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's do this! We'll crush $$フル・フロンタル$$ here!」

521:t_002:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Join up with us, $$シャア$$!」

521:t_003:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Let's settle this, $$フロンタル$$!」

521:t_003:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even I now understand that it's impossible for me to walk the same path as you.」

521:t_003:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And I've realized I feel the same displeasure toward you that you feel toward me.」

521:t_003:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So there's no need for two of you in this world.」

521:t_004:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're not the only one who wants to settle things with that man.」

521:t_004:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't apologize. Otherwise, I'll want to make you alone the villain again.」

521:t_004:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「First, we'll take down $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

521:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our target is $$フロンタル$$'s $$シナンジュ$$! Take him down, and the battle is decided!」

521:t_005:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You can do this, $$バナージ$$?」

521:t_005:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I rejected the world he envisions. So I'll see this through!」

521:t_005:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Come, $$シャア$$, $$アムロ$$, $$ハマーン$$... and you, $$バナージ$$.」

521:t_005:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The world is rushing toward its conclusion. Let us begin its preliminary battle.」
